title: chemistry-framework: configuration-driven, evidence-guided molecular property prediction
description:
chemistry-framework is the analysis code accompanying the manuscript Evidence-Guided Molecular Property Modelling with a Configuration-Driven Modular Framework. It implements (i) a training-partition feature-evidence scorecard for RDKit 2D descriptors, (ii) a rule-based recommender that maps scorecard evidence to a descriptor budget and a feature subset, (iii) a modular predictor that separates the physicochemical prior, the graph residual and their fusion, and (iv) the benchmark runners that produced every number, table and figure in the manuscript.

The archive contains the archived per-split results (benchmarks/results/) and the 20 Bemis-Murcko scaffold manifests per endpoint (benchmarks/splits/), so the reported statistics can be recomputed without retraining any model. benchmarks/paper_statistics.py regenerates all paired comparisons (Nadeau-Bengio corrected resampled t intervals with Holm-Bonferroni multiplicity control), and benchmarks/validate_paper_statistics.py checks the archived numbers against the values printed in the manuscript.

Scope: the release covers the manuscript benchmark only. The follow-up feature-space work (SIREN routing) is not part of this version.
notes: Replace the placeholder creator name and affiliation with the final author list of the manuscript before creating the Zenodo release. See RELEASE_NOTES.md for the release checklist.
